mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference image 1 is the SUBJECT and STYLE reference: draw this same stack of split firewood under its thatched lean-to roof, with the same log colours, flat posterized colour fills, thin ink outlines and muted palette.
Reference image 2 is a style reference only (a scene from the game Card Survival: Fantasy Forest): match its rendering; do not copy its subject.
Draw the Town Wood Pile, zoomed in on just the pile: a tall, neat stack of split firewood logs with pale cut ends facing the viewer, under a simple lean-to with a mossy thatched roof on two rough wooden posts, standing on packed earth with a little green grass at its foot. The woodpile fills most of the card from edge to edge; only a narrow strip of grey overcast sky and the dark green edge of a pine forest show above and beside the roof.
Framing: tight close view from the front at standing eye level, the stack and lean-to filling the frame.
Style: flat posterized colour fills in a few tonal steps, cel-like, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture; thin dark ink outlines and small ink hatch marks on the bark and cut ends; a muted naturalistic palette of tan, brown, moss green and grey; nothing glossy. The painted scene reaches every edge of the frame. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: footprints, tracks, prints in the ground or snow, the village square, cobblestones, a well, houses, cottages, people, axe, chopping block, wide shot, photo, 3D render, glossy highlights, golden glow, plain white background, vignette, white border.
